problems: a transient stored-PDF download failure was silently converted to a record-only item and the incremental cursor advanced, permanently skipping the real PDF until the Zotero item changed again
an existing record-only item did not download a PDF added later in Zotero because updates always preserved the local placeholder
lastSyncAt was global instead of scoped by Zotero user and workspace
startup auto-sync failures were silent and settings buttons allowed duplicate sync launches
fixes: require a valid PDF response when a stored attachment exists and PDF download is requested
retain the incremental cursor on PDF download or validation failure
download a remote PDF when an existing Zotero item is still source_kind=record
incremental sync separately scans changed stored-PDF attachments and backfills their parent items, because adding an attachment does not always bump the parent item version
replace record PDF and Markdown through the operation journal with backups and DB source-state commit
report per-item failure reasons through the sync result and IPC
scope lastSyncAt by Zotero user and normalized library path
disable full/incremental buttons while a Zotero sync launch is active
coreCases: HTTP 503 while downloading a stored PDF leaves failed=1, imported=0 and cursor unchanged
an attachment-only change retrieves the unchanged parent and upgrades source_kind to pdf
remote PDF added after an initial record-only sync upgrades source_kind to pdf
upgrade writes a committed zotero.sync_pdf operation with a preserved backup
existing local notes and exact paths remain intact
